title: One of our clients is looking for someone with a strong emphasis in digital elec
text:
One of our clients is looking for someone with a strong emphasis in digital electronics  microprocessor  FPGA design, embedded software, and Xilinx experience a plus.
Qualifications
Candidates may be using the following software:VivadoAltiumMATLAB  SimulinkMicro-Cap circuit simulationLTspiceDymolaCandidates must have a Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering and 6 or more years of electronic circuit design experience.
